channel.title: Routa Bank – news and press releases
channel.description: News, press releases and articles from the fictional Routa Bank. All content is fiction.

item.title: Routa opens a third Helsinki branch in Kannelmäki
item.description: Routa Bank opens a branch in Kannelmäki, Helsinki in April. It is the bank's third Helsinki branch. The branch network grows to 40 cities during the spring.

item.title: How to compare home loans
item.description: Comparing home loans comes down to the margin, the annual percentage rate and the fees – not the slogan. This guide shows how to compare properly.

item.title: Routa Bank in 2025 – customer base grew to 468,000
item.description: Routa Bank results for 2025. 468,000 customers at year end, 790 employees and 38 branches. Revenue of 162 million euros.
